summary: Reserving-class listings, dataset and method window loads, and the Project Settings table summary can now load through the ArcRho Server instead of the network drive.
details: When the ArcRho Save Gateway advertises the read, the server reads the reserving-class index, cached dataset, method JSON, or master table on its own disk and returns only the result, so a stale index rebuild or a large table summary no longer opens every file over the mapped drive.
A read the gateway does not advertise, or that cannot reach the gateway, loads locally exactly as before; the transport used is recorded in the local client_read_latency.jsonl diagnostics log.
